_note: The Assignment Sheet: a 2D10 (1..100) table per Campaign Season group,
plus the separate Spain table. Both are empty until transcribed - until
then the app asks 'rolled 47, which Command?' instead of guessing.
Ranges are inclusive on both ends and must not overlap. Add a 'note' to
an entry to carry over the 'Assignment Sheet notes if any' text; the app
shows it verbatim when that entry comes up.
If different Campaign Seasons use different tables, give each table its
own id and point campaignSeasons.json at it via 'assignmentTableId'.
